name: dumbbell lying triceps extension v. 2
description: A classic lying extension that isolates the triceps by bending only at the elbows.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Straighten your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
